3d_v4.note: units run largest-first (56-query units); the mix of the remaining units can shift the rate

3d_audit_and_100pct_replay_passed.assumes: audit 5-15 min + replay 0.5-1.5 h on 12 workers

canary_passed_drain_partition_launch.assumes: 16-root canary ~860 tasks on 12 workers 30-45 min, drain <= 5 min, partition 5-10 min

q2_complete_with_spillover.assumes: ~235,400 tasks left at the hand-off; laptop 3,000/h + gvlab 12 workers at 20 (15-30) CPU-s/query = 2,160 (1,440-2,880)/h; the owner map balances the two hosts by canary throughput so both finish together

q2_complete_laptop_only_for_comparison.note: 235,400 / 3,000 per h = 78.5 h after the hand-off time

uncertainties: gvlab per-query CPU time is unknown until the canary; it sets both the share and the end date
each laptop swap-guard stop (see reports/) pauses the laptop share until a manual resume
the queue does not hand off before every gate passes; a BLOCKED_* state leaves the laptop original running alone (laptop-only ETA applies)
